**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (cel-go), living in internal/filter (internal/filter/engine.go, imports github.com/google/cel-go/cel at line 9). Mechanism: the ListMemos filter string is parsed by the CEL Engine into a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then `Program.Render`/`CompileToStatement` with a `RenderOptions.Dialect` (DialectSQLite/DialectPostgres/DialectMySQL) renders it into a dialect-specific SQL WHERE fragment (internal/filter/engine.go:74–98, render.go).

**q26.** memo_relation, attachment, and memo (store/memo.go:140–158 explicitly cleans memo_relation and attachment rows before deleting the memo row).

**q27.** Mechanism: the compiled React app is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served as static files (with SPA fallback to index.html). Wired in server/router/frontend/frontend.go (embed at lines 20–21, static middleware at lines 54–59, SPA fallback at 63–77).

**q28.**
- s3presign runner — time.Ticker every 12 hours (runnerInterval = 12h), plus a RunOnce at startup (server/server.go:162–169; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27,29)

Unused-infra note: `server/runner/memopayload` exists as a runner package (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go), but the server never starts its Runner — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline by the memo handlers (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447). No memopayload runner is scheduled in startBackgroundRunners.

**q29.** Interceptor: web/src/connect.ts (`authInterceptor`, line 156; registered at line 188). Token kinds: an access token (Bearer, in localStorage as `memos_access_token`) and a refresh token (used to mint new access tokens via RefreshToken; managed in web/src/auth-state.ts and connect.ts). Backend package that validates them: server/auth (server/auth/authenticator.go, token.go — e.g. ParseRefreshToken/GenerateAccessTokenV2).

**q30.** Memo lifecycle events → dispatch functions (all in server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go):
- created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 15)
- updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (line 20)
- deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (line 25)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 30)

They all converge on the private `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48), which calls `webhook.PostAsync` → delivery in internal/webhook/webhook.go (Post at line 120).
